TAU AUTONOMY CENTER AS describes itself on its website as: "Tau Autonomy Center offer functional test and training facilities for air and sea based autonomous drones and an infrastructure built specifically for testing purposes".
TAU AUTONOMY CENTER AS is a private limited company (AS), founded on 2020-01-06, registered in Strand.
It reported revenue of NOK 433,980 for 2025 and an operating result of NOK 34,656 (2025).
Its 2025 accounts show an operating margin of 8.0% and a strong equity ratio of 89% of total assets.
Revenue fell 61.4% from 2024 to 2025 (NOK 1.12M to NOK 433,980); it was NOK 1.47M in 2023. The annual result was a profit in 2025, as in 2024 (2023: -NOK 19,715, 2024: NOK 746,362, 2025: NOK 23,172).
TAU AUTONOMY CENTER AS is led by board chair Bjørn Aril Veland.
It has a board of 8. The register last recorded a change to its roles on 2024-07-10.
